tips.text: Bring Revenant or Nyx to the Showdown; Valkyr and Dante with Overguard spam also work.
Kill DJ RoM first in a Duet; his Toxin skips shields and kills Gauss.
Take a squad to the Showdown for one extra Heartcell per Coda beaten, up to three, or go solo if four Codas take too long.
Hunt Coda nodes through bounties; the Antivirus bounty is often on one, so you restock mods while disinfecting.
Slot Quick Correct for a 10% chance of a Heartcell on each correct stab; it adds up across several Codas.
Abort after a correct stab; the progress banks, but Quick Correct Heartcells are lost.
Restart the Showdown if an invisible band member or a host migration softlock breaks the run.
Wait for a good roll if you can; a 60% copy means you never need a second one to fuse.
For Mastery alone, buy whatever roll is up; the bonus only matters if you use the gun.
Expect one Coda in an hour or two; players call it far less painful than Liches or Sisters.
Players mostly regret hunting before Mastery Rank 17 or skipping a 60% roll.
Run the Antivirus Bounty on Steel Path for extra standing.
